description.zh: WgetCloud 是面向外贸企业、涉外投资机构及高端商务用户的行业标杆，全线采用优质企业级专线与 Trojan 协议，测速数据显示其各节点性能均处第一梯队。
description.en: WgetCloud is a high-performance cross-border proxy provider. Featuring Enterprise IPLC / Trojan, High Redundancy / 59 Active Nodes, and full support for Netflix, 4K YouTube streaming, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Starting at ¥99/月.
